decision.comment: Preprocessing stage is clean and internally consistent. All deterministic checks pass with an empty deterministic_findings list. Key verifications: (1) Image shape 28×28×3 matches the standard MedMNIST distribution; (2) Split sizes (89996/10004/7180) exactly match official PathMNIST splits with no subsampling; (3) 9-class multi-class schema is coherent; (4) Augmented train size 359984 = 89996 × 4 (augmentation factor) is arithmetically correct; (5) Normalization stats are drawn from train only (train_stats_only=true), preventing leakage; (6) The three augmentations in the representation plan (hflip, brightness, contrast) are all built-in primitives and do not require extension approval; (7) The two pending extension proposals (hflip_only_aug, compact_conv_token_transformer) are in pending_review status and do not invalidate the built-in primitives already in use; per policy, generic transformer fields are inactive for CNN families. Non-blocking warnings carried forward: (a) llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8—exact LLM weights are not pinned in the run manifest (auxiliary component); (b) the test set originates from a different clinical center, so the downstream OOD aggregate must use the arithmetic mean of per-severity AUROCs, not a pooled-sample AUROC; (c) two prior-art quotes (GhostNet-VGG robustness ranking, temperature-scaling caveat) extend beyond the truncated source text and should be verified against the full papers before being relied upon in design decisions; (d) the augmentation_model_quality inference generalises beyond the narrower scope of its cited quote. None of these warnings block progression. Proceed to the next stage.
issues: llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8; exact LLM weights are not pinned in the run manifest (auxiliary, non-blocking).
Test set is cross-domain (different clinical center); downstream OOD aggregate must use arithmetic mean of per-severity AUROCs, not pooled-sample AUROC.

augmentation_model_quality inference generalises beyond the narrower scope of its cited quote (unlearning quality vs. overall model quality/robustness).

No clinical claims. The supplied current UTC timestamp is authoritative. This pipeline uses the standard 28x28 RGB MedMNIST distribution; do not substitute the source-dataset or MedMNIST+ resolution. Only deterministic findings may justify action=stop; unsupported external-memory claims must be warnings requesting verification. ResNet18 has fixed topology; hidden controls base width and depth is ignored. Generic transformer fields are inactive for CNN families and do not make them transformer hybrids. Built-in augmentations (hflip, vflip, rotate90, rotate180, brightness, contrast) do not require extension approval; pending new proposals do not invalidate these primitives. A cited quote establishes traceability, not support for every scientific inference: assess that support separately. The OOD aggregate is the arithmetic mean of the selected score's AUROCs across corruption severities, not a pooled-sample AUROC.
